nom: Sun Bum Mineral Liquid Face SPF 30​

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin have mixed experiences: some find it sits too wet or greasy and recommend avoiding it or setting it with powder, while others with an oily T-zone still find it manageable for daily wear.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe the formula as serum-like and hydrating, giving a glowy finish without dryness.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin find it lightweight with minimal white cast, though it can look somewhat oily-shiny on the skin and one reviewer felt repeated reapplication left pores feeling clogged.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin repeatedly report no irritation, stinging or breakouts, including those who are fragrance-sensitive or acne-prone; several call it their go-to sunscreen for sensitive skin.
segments.normal: One reviewer with normal skin found the formula heavy, balmy and pasty rather than drying down, suspecting it suits dry skin better than normal skin.

concerns.dehydration: Reviewers with dry skin describe the formula as hydrating and glowy rather than drying, though one reviewer with normal skin found it left an unexpectedly heavy, pasty finish.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers who describe themselves as acne-prone or teen-acne report the sunscreen does not cause new breakouts and, for a few, their skin looks clearer with regular use; no reviewer reports it triggering breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin have mixed results: some find it sits wet and need powder on top or recommend avoiding it, while others say it controls shine well enough for daily wear without excess greasiness.

aspects.libelle: Long dry-down time before it sets
Initial white cast blends away with rubbing
Leaves a lingering white cast on deeper skin tones
Makes makeup pill for some users
Compact bottle, easy to travel with
Wish the SPF were higher than 30

extraits.texte: This sunscreen seemed promising because of some of the reviews however as someone with a normal skin type this felt so heavy on my skin. I tried wearing this without moisturizer to try and see if it would mitigate the feeling but it didn't. After the dry down, it felt balmy and pasty at the same time. I can see how someone with dry skin would like this but I do not.

let me start by saying, i absolutely love the packaging of this sunscreen. the dropper allows you to get just the right amount for a face application. i also love the consistency and finish of this product, it is super lightweight and non-greasy. the only downside to this product is the fact that is isn't suitable for my melanated skin tones and leaves and awful white cast as does most sunscreens. i'm disappointed because i would love to add spf into my skincare regimen but it is a constant struggle for the chocolate girls. overall it doesn't work for me but might be wonderful for someone else.

A good everyday sunscreen for sensitive skin. It feels a little greasy until absorbed. I would avoid if your skin is oily. It goes on white and drys clear. Provides good protection when applied correctly. There is no scent.

I love this sunscreen. I use it every day on my face! My skin is very sensitive and acne-prone, and I have had no issues with using this product on my face. My face seems clearer with this sunscreen than with others I have tried. The product is very easy to rub in and sits nicely on my skin without leaving a white cast. It initially is very dewy when first applied, but the product sinks into the skin well. My skin gets oily throughout the day, and I find this product works well without being too drying.

extraits.titre: I found my new fave mineral face spf!!
extraits.texte: A mineral spf that doesn't irritate,sting eyes or make me pasty white!Goes on liquidy smooth, feels like serum, perfect for dry skin & only slightly milky white after reapplying( but almost immediately blended awayi)My new holy grail for sunny days!!

I received Sum Bum Mineral 30 Sheer Suncreen Face Lotion from Influenster in exchange for my honest review. I was excited to test out this product because I prefer to wear mineral sunscreen. Chemical sunscreen burns my eyes so I try to avoid it. I was impressed with how sheer the formula is. It applies as a white liquid but turns sheer as soon as you rub it into the skin. I appreciate that it is fragrance free. It did not irritate my sensitive skin and it was very hydrating. It might be too much if you have super oily skin. I liked how it made my dry skin look glowy.
